class_ratio_description: Positive/negative ratio on the test partition: 22.1 / 77.9.
pr_auc_emphasis_rationale: PR-AUC is reported as a secondary discriminator on decision-cost grounds. Adverse-action denials carry asymmetric operational cost (regulatory disclosure, customer friction, appeal handling), so precision/recall trade-offs above ROC-AUC's rank-only view are policy-relevant. The prevalence-driven interpretation of PR-AUC is dataset-dependent — reported here as a raw ratio rather than assigned a categorical label.
